India Experiences 14% Rainfall Deficit Despite August Showers

India has recorded a 14% deficit in rainfall between June and August. While some regions experienced heavy downpours causing distress, the overall deficit persists. The situation is exacerbated by the El Niño phenomenon, leading to drought-like conditions in several states and posing a threat to crops.
